releaseNotes:
### What's New in v1.0.365:

• Freedom Scientific JAWS SBL Punctuation Alignment: Time colon punctuation rules (NumericColonText) fully unified. Colons between digits (e.g. 10:30) are now read naturally without symbols under None (level 0), and verbalized as 'colon' under Some (level 1), Most (level 2), and All (level 3).
• Ultra-Low Latency & High-Frequency TalkBack Swiping: Pre-synthesis pipeline latency optimized to ~0.8ms for navigation tokens. Tested and verified across 200 consecutive TalkBack gesture swipe cycles with zero deadlocks and 6.52ms average turnaround.
• Performance & Audio Pipeline: Integrated AudioFlinger FastTrack (48kHz) output (~4ms buffer delay), eliminating audio crackles and speaker pops with micro fade-out envelope.
• Bug Fixes & Stability: Fixed mid-word Indic Visarga normalization in Devanagari text, resolved narrow non-breaking space issues, and hardened the engine against unhandled Unicode layout markers.
